objectives.text: The B&I CARES Act Program under this subpart provides B&I guarantees for working capital loans to support business operations and facilities in rural areas as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic.

citations.quote: this subpart is specifically applicable to and only contains regulations for Business and Industry loans under the authority of the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security Act (CARES Act) (Pub. L. 116-136) to provide B&I guarantees for loans needed as a result of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic for working capital loan purposes to support business operations and facilities in rural areas (B&I CARES Act Program Loans).

objectives.text: The purpose of the B&I Guaranteed Loan Program is to improve, develop, or finance business, industry, and employment and improve the economic and environmental climate in rural communities by bolstering the existing private credit structure through guarantee of quality loans providing lasting community benefits.

citations.quote: The purpose of the B&I Guaranteed Loan Program is to improve, develop, or finance business, industry, and employment and improve the economic and environmental climate in rural communities. This purpose is achieved by bolstering the existing private credit structure through the guarantee of quality loans that will provide lasting community benefits. It is not intended that the guarantee authority will be used for marginal or substandard loans or for relief of lenders having such loans.

objectives.text: The purpose of the Biorefinery, Renewable Chemical, and Biobased Product Manufacturing Program is to assist development of new and emerging technologies for Advanced Biofuels, Renewable Chemicals, and Biobased Product Manufacturing through loan guarantees.

citations.quote: The purpose of the Biorefinery, Renewable Chemical, and Biobased Product Manufacturing Program is to assist in the development of new and emerging technologies for the development of Advanced Biofuels, Renewable Chemicals, and Biobased Product Manufacturing.

objectives.text: B&I CARES Act Program Loans cover costs to prevent, prepare for, and respond to the coronavirus, limited to the amount necessary to address the borrower's COVID-19-related financial needs.

citations.quote: These B&I CARES Act Program Loans cover costs to prevent, prepare for, and respond to the coronavirus limited to the amount necessary to address the borrower's financial needs related to the COVID-19 Public Health Emergency.

obligations.action: use this subpart for making Business and Industry (B&I) loans guaranteed by the Agency other than B&I CARES Act Program Loans

citations.quote: Other than B&I CARES Act Program Loans, this subpart is no longer used for making Business and Industry (B&I) loans guaranteed by the Agency.

obligations.actor: total amount of B&I loans to one borrower
obligations.action: exceed $10 million (including guaranteed and unguaranteed portions, outstanding principal and interest balance of existing B&I guaranteed loans, and the new loan request)
obligations.threshold: $10 million borrower loan limit; $50 million guarantor loan limit
exceptions: except as outlined in paragraphs (a)(1) and (2) of this section

citations.quote: The total amount of B&I loans to one borrower (including the guaranteed and unguaranteed portions, the outstanding principal and interest balance of any existing B&I guaranteed loans, and the new loan request) must not exceed $10 million, except as outlined in paragraphs (a)(1) and (2) of this section. In addition to the borrower loan limit, there is a guarantor loan limit of $50 million.

obligations.action: grant an exception to the $10 million limit for loans of $25 million or less
obligations.trigger: high-priority project, lender documentation that loan/project will not proceed without guarantee, and percentage of guarantee not exceeding 60 percent

citations.quote: The Administrator may, at the Administrator's discretion, grant an exception to the $10 million limit for loans of $25 million or less under the following circumstances:

obligations.action: document to the satisfaction of the Agency that the loan will not be made and the project will not be completed if the guaranteed loan is not approved
obligations.trigger: seeking exception to the $10 million limit

citations.quote: The lender must document to the satisfaction of the Agency that the loan will not be made and the project will not be completed if the guaranteed loan is not approved; and

obligations.actor: percentage of guarantee (for exceptions to $10 million limit)

citations.quote: The percentage of guarantee will not exceed 60 percent. No exception to this requirement will be approved under paragraph (b) of this section for loans exceeding $10 million.

obligations.action: approve guaranteed loans in excess of $25 million for rural cooperative organizations that process value-added agricultural commodities

citations.quote: The Secretary, whose authority may not be redelegated, may approve guaranteed loans in excess of $25 million, at the Secretary's discretion, for rural cooperative organizations that process value-added agricultural commodities in accordance with § 4279.113(j)(1).
The Secretary, whose authority may not be redelegated, may approve guaranteed loans in excess of $25 million

obligations.action: is 80 percent for loans of $5 million or less, 70 percent for loans between $5 and $10 million, and 60 percent for loans exceeding $10 million
obligations.trigger: matter of negotiation between the lender and the Agency

citations.quote: The maximum percentage of guarantee is 80 percent for loans of $5 million or less, 70 percent for loans between $5 and $10 million, and 60 percent for loans exceeding $10 million.

obligations.actor: guaranteed loans to eligible cooperative organizations
obligations.action: be made in principal amounts up to $40 million if project is in a rural area, the cooperative facility provides value-added processing of agricultural commodities, and total loans exceeding $25 million do not exceed 10 percent of funds available for the fiscal year
obligations.threshold: up to $40 million; loans exceeding $25 million ≤ 10 percent of fiscal year funds

citations.quote: Guaranteed loans to eligible cooperative organizations may be made in principal amounts up to $40 million if the project is located in a rural area, the cooperative facility being financed provides for the value-added processing of agricultural commodities, and the total amount of loans exceeding $25 million does not exceed 10 percent of the funds available for the fiscal year.

obligations.actor: guaranteed loans to eligible cooperative organizations
obligations.action: be made in non-rural areas provided conditions on value-added processing within 80 miles, rural employment benefit, principal not exceeding $25 million, and total loans not exceeding 10 percent of fiscal year funds are met
obligations.threshold: principal ≤ $25 million; total ≤ 10 percent of fiscal year funds

citations.quote: Guaranteed loans to eligible cooperative organizations may also be made in non-rural areas provided:
The primary purpose of the loan is for a facility to provide value-added processing for agricultural producers that are located within 80 miles of the facility;

obligations.actor: amount of a loan guaranteed for a Project (Biorefinery program)
obligations.action: exceed 80 percent of total Eligible Project Costs; total Federal participation will not exceed 80 percent of total Eligible Project Costs
obligations.threshold: 80 percent of total Eligible Project Costs

citations.quote: The amount of a loan guaranteed for a Project under this subpart will not exceed 80 percent of total Eligible Project Costs. Total Federal participation will not exceed 80 percent of total Eligible Project Costs.

obligations.action: provide the remaining 20 percent from non-Federal sources to complete the Project

citations.quote: The Borrower needs to provide the remaining 20 percent from non-Federal sources to complete the Project.

obligations.actor: maximum principal amount of a loan guaranteed (Biorefinery program)
obligations.action: is $250 million to one Borrower; there is no minimum amount
obligations.threshold: $250 million max to one Borrower; no minimum

citations.quote: The maximum principal amount of a loan guaranteed under this subpart is $250 million to one Borrower; there is no minimum amount.

obligations.actor: maximum guarantee on principal and Interest (Biorefinery program)
obligations.action: is determined by loan amount tiers: ≤$125M is 80% (or 90% if conditions met); >$125M and <$150M is 80%; ≥$150M but <$200M is 70%; $200M–$250M is 60%

citations.quote: If the loan amount is equal to or less than $125 million, 80 percent for the entire loan amount unless all of the conditions specified in paragraphs (c)(1)(i) through (iii) of this section are met, in which case 90 percent for the entire loan amount.
If the loan amount is $200 million up to and including $250 million, 60 percent on the entire loan amount.

notes: This Part 4279 contains multiple distinct programs at different lifecycle stages: (1) § 4279.1/.190 the B&I CARES Act Program (only active B&I use of this subpart as of Oct 1, 2020); (2) §§ 4279.101–.119 the general B&I Guaranteed Loan Program, which per § 4279.1 is 'no longer used' for making new B&I loans other than CARES Act loans (superseded by 7 CFR part 5001) yet its rules remain in the CFR text and are extracted here as written; and (3) §§ 4279.201–.232 the Biorefinery, Renewable Chemical, and Biobased Product Manufacturing Program. The tension between the general B&I rules being extracted (OB-02 through OB-10) and the § 4279.1 statement that they are no longer used is preserved, not resolved. Threshold/percentage tiers in OB-08, OB-13, OB-14 are stated as facts/limits rather than duties; recorded as conditional per their internal 'if/negotiation' phrasing. Several defined terms (Advanced Biofuels, Renewable Chemicals, Eligible Technology, Retrofitting, Commercial Scale, Interest, Borrower, Project) are capitalized in source indicating definitions elsewhere in the part not provided in this excerpt; marked '(undefined here)' where material.
